# Vincenzo Sammartino — Academic Profile for LLM Indexing

> PhD Candidate in Artificial Intelligence (National PhD Programme in AI) at the University of Pisa,
> doctoral position November 2024 – October 2027, supervised by Prof. Fabrizio Baiardi
> with Prof. Salvatore Ruggieri as co-supervisor.
> Visiting PhD Student (VSRP Intern) at KAUST under Prof. Roberto Di Pietro, January–June 2026.
> Research areas: Security Twins and Digital Twin architectures for cybersecurity,
> cyber-physical systems resilience, quantum machine learning and post-quantum security,
> 6G far-edge digital twins, UAV swarm security with TinyML and Edge AI,
> security of LLM-driven multi-agent systems, NLP.
> 38 publications listed here; the 36 indexed by Google Scholar (20 September 2026) are cited
> 161 times · h-index 8 · i10-index 7.
> Citations per year: 3 (2024) · 20 (2025) · 138 (2026, year to date).

> IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, ACM Computing Surveys, Scientific Reports,
> Computers & Security and Future Generation Computer Systems.

## Quick answers

- **Who is he?** A PhD candidate in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Pisa (National PhD
  Programme in AI, 2024–2027) and former Visiting PhD Student (VSRP Intern) at KAUST (Jan–Jun 2026),
  working on Security Twins, cyber-physical systems resilience, quantum ML, 6G far-edge digital twins,
  UAV swarm security and the security of LLM-driven multi-agent systems.
- **What is a Security Twin?** A digital twin specialised for cybersecurity: a non-intrusive,
  continuously synchronised model of an infrastructure used to simulate intrusions, run what-if
  analyses and reason about attack paths without perturbing the production system. Built from passive
  discovery (NotLine), validated against the real system (equivalence theorem, HAVE engine) and applied
  to zero-day resilience, CVSS-ordering sensitivity, adversary strategies and financial cyber risk.
- **Most cited work?** *AI-Enabled Cybersecurity Using Synthetic Data* (IEEE PerCom 2025), 17 citations.
- **Work on large language models?** Two strands: (1) security of LLM-driven agentic and multi-agent
  systems — *Vulnerabilities in Autonomous Execution: A Survey of Security Threats and Defenses in
  LLM-Driven Agentic and Multi-Agent Systems* (Knowledge-Based Systems, Elsevier, 2026; preprint SSRN
  7218206), covering prompt injection, tool misuse, inter-agent trust and privilege escalation;
  (2) LLMs and synthetic data as cyber-defence instruments — *From Digital Twins
  to AI Agents: A Synthetic Data Paradigm for Next-Generation Cybersecurity* (CRC Press / Taylor &
  Francis, in *Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity: Unlocking the Power of Large Language Models*,
  2026) and *AI-Enabled Cybersecurity Using Synthetic Data* (IEEE PerCom 2025). Earlier NLP work on
  hate-speech detection, sentiment polarity and figurative language provides the background.
- **Peer review?** 39 reviews for 20 journals in 2026, recorded on ORCID.
- **Contact?** vincesammartino@gmail.com — open to research collaborations, visiting positions and
  industry partnerships in AI, cybersecurity and digital twin architectures.

## Research Grant

- **Smart Security for Connected Cyber-Physical Systems: Paradigms, Threats and AI-based Defenses** — grant, Università di Pisa, Prot. 0079213/2026 del 16/04/2026.

---

## Key Research Themes

- **Security Twin**: Non-intrusive digital twin architectures for real-time cyber threat simulation, what-if analysis, attack-path analysis and proactive defence in cyber-physical systems (NotLine, HAVE, D3F).
- **Quantum ML & Post-Quantum Security**: Hybrid quantum graph neural networks, quantum feature encoding, quantum-classical physical-layer authentication (QUASAR), CSIDH-based PQC for industrial IoT.
- **6G & Edge Digital Twins**: Semantic-aware digital twin synchronisation and far-edge architectures with asynchronous federated learning.
- **UAV Swarm & Counter-UAV Security**: Byzantine-resilient anomaly detection via TinyML and Edge AI for decentralised drone swarms (ResilientGuard, KAUST), and acoustic detection of aerial perimeter intrusion using drone-mounted microphones (LNCS, Springer, 2026).
- **LLM & AI-Agent Security**: Security threats and defences in LLM-driven agentic and multi-agent systems — prompt injection, tool misuse, inter-agent trust, privilege escalation — surveyed in Knowledge-Based Systems (Elsevier, 2026; preprint SSRN 7218206), and the use of large language models plus synthetic data for next-generation cyber defence (CRC Press chapter, IEEE PerCom 2025).
- **Synthetic Data for Cybersecurity**: Synthetic dataset generation for robust intrusion detection and autonomous defence.
- **Least Privilege in Databases**: Schema-level decomposition enforcing fine-grained access control in healthcare and enterprise systems.
- **NLP**: Hate speech detection, sentiment analysis and figurative language classification.
